description: EMB-326GB Xavante displayed at the entrance of CENIPA; serial per AeroEntusiasta Feb 2026 (ABRAPAC 2019 listed three unidentified aircraft at the CENIPA entrance).
EMB-110 Bandeirante (c/n 110123) displayed at CENIPA; the same serial was listed at Base Aérea do Recife in 2019, so it evidently moved to Brasília; Feb 2026 list.
Ex-Brazilian Navy Sea King displayed at CENIPA (aviagraphers describe it near a side gate of the Brasília airport military area; Feb 2026 list).
